purpose: Reconcile what the cached acquisition row says with what the fixed material itself shows. The cached row is not rewritten here; the differences are recorded so nothing downstream inherits an empty field as a fact.

evidence: publisher PDF physical page 1 cover: 'Ning Guo & Fei Liu' above the title
landing HTML object 52/52b999…: two citation_author metas, 'Ning Guo' and 'Fei Liu'

Steklov Mathematical Institute and e-mail guo.ning@eimi.ru, and \author[\initial{F.} \lastname{Liu}]{...} with address Southern University of Science and Technology, Shenzhen, and e-mail liufei54@pku.edu.cn

differences.resolution: the cached empty list is an extraction gap, not an anonymous work. Both authors are recorded in SOURCE.json and NOTICE.txt from the material; the cached row is left as found and is cited as the source of the discrepancy
differences.consequence_if_unreconciled: an empty author field would have silently produced an unattributed redistribution, which the CC BY 4.0 grant requires to be attributed

differences.material_shows: the article landing page, the publisher PDF and the native TeX are three separately cached assets of one article; the printed version is Tome 11 (2024), p. 187-246
differences.resolution: SOURCE.json records all three artefacts with their separate URLs and catalog objects; the unit's source_version is the printed one, not the cache's internal label
differences.note: the cache's 'tex'-only view would have hidden that a publisher render exists, and with it the printed page map and the 45 reference entries

differences.material_shows: this article's own 2024 cover states CC BY 4.0 ('© Les auteurs, 2024.' followed by the CC BY 4.0 sentence) and the landing page states 'Licence : CC-BY 4.0'
differences.resolution: the cached string is a journal-wide rule of thumb covering both eras; the article-level evidence is used in LICENCE_ADMISSION.json, and the two agree for a 2024 article. Recorded so a later reader does not mistake the pre-2019 clause for a live restriction.

differences.material_shows: the same five plus mathalfa.sty (required at line 6), colonequals.sty (line 64) and cleveref.sty (line 65), all absent from the local TinyTeX tree by kpsewhich
differences.resolution: the concrete eight-item list is recorded in SOURCE.json compile_blocked_by and READER_RECEIPT.json missing_original_attachments

differences.material_shows: the material is complete for text reading and carries a full author proof of the retained unit; what is 'missing' is the publisher's compilation support, not the mathematical content
differences.resolution: SOURCE.json state is 'source_complete_for_text_and_pdf_reading_not_native_project_complete'; the unit does not claim any compile, and the status word 'missing_materials' must not be read as missing mathematics
